Dr. Edward McLaughlin - Dr. Ed is a Chiropractor located in Sarasota, FL.  After graduating from Eckerd College with a degree in Biology and a minor in Chemistry in 2004, he went on to earn his Doctorate from Palmer College of Chiropractic graduating with honors in 2007.  Dr. Ed has been practicing in Sarasota, FL for over 17 years and loves helping patients from all around the world. The technique he uses is different. The McLaughlin Method is Integrative Chiropractic. It incorporates a wide range of modalities including: manual adjustments, soft tissue therapy, gua sha, corrective stretching, and extensive education to help patients get relief and properly care for their spines. Dr. Ed is a gifted teacher and is passionate about patient education and getting to the root cause. This channel shows chiropractic cracks, massage, and treatment that brings relief!
